$comment: Catalogue entries this pipeline provides, to be ingested into the Agora catalogue. Run details (retrieval date, checksum) are in the output's provinces.meta.json.

key.name: ine_code
key.description: INE province code: two digits, 01–52 (51 Ceuta and 52 Melilla are autonomous cities with province codes).

relation_types.description: The province belongs to the autonomous community (Ceuta and Melilla: the autonomous city itself).

datasets.title: Provincias de España (IGN, unidades administrativas INSPIRE)

validity.description: The service publishes the current state of IGN's administrative boundaries, without validity dates; the data is valid as of its retrieval date.

excluded.name: Territorios no asociados a ninguna provincia
excluded.reason: The plazas de soberanía are not one of INE's provinces.

geometry.resolution: full (as published by IGN, not simplified)

fields.name: name
fields.description: Official name as published by IGN; bilingual where official (e.g. 'Alacant/Alicante').

fields.name: ccaa_code
fields.description: INE code of the autonomous community.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: Catalogue id of the autonomous community (es:ine:ccaa:{ccaa_code}).
